senses.en: a solid silvery grey radioactive transuranic element whose atoms can be split when bombarded with neutrons; found in minute quantities in uranium ores but is usually synthesized in nuclear reactors; 13 isotopes are known with the most important being plutonium 239
senses.zh: 固态银灰色放射性超铀元素,其原子在中子爆炸时可以分裂;在铀矿石中发现,数量微量,但通常在核反应堆中合成;已知的同位素有13种,其中最重要的一种是钚239。
